title: Can you help me?
instructions: Emma komşusundan yardım istiyor. Kısa bir diyalog; ne istediğine ve ne zaman olduğuna dikkat et.

script.speaker: emma
script.text: Hi, David. I'm going away for the weekend. Could you water my plants?

script.speaker: neighbour
script.text: Sure, no problem. When are you leaving?

script.speaker: emma
script.text: On Friday evening. I'll leave the key under the mat.

script.speaker: neighbour
script.text: Don't do that. Just give it to me on Friday.

questions.prompt: What does Emma ask David to do?
Where does Emma want to leave the key?
questions.evidence: I'll leave the key under the mat.

options: leaving the key under the mat
giving him the key on Friday
questions.feedback: Paspasın altına bırakmasın; cuma günü ona versin.
questions.evidence: Just give it to me on Friday.
